subject: Vendor roster + SCC/KMS checklist for EU customer onboarding
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor roster + SCC/KMS checklist for EU customer onboarding

Hi team,

We received a security/compliance intake from FinServe (see below). They're kicking off a pilot in the EU and legal asked for:

- A current vendor/subprocessor roster (who touches customer content)
- Indication of where keys are managed (KMS/HSM) for any EU-customer keys
- Whether we have SCCs or need DPA addenda for cross-border flows
- A simple dataflow diagram that shows any cross-border transfers

Can Marissa own assembling the vendor roster CSV and a short row for each vendor that includes: vendor name, role, data types processed, region of processing, whether we have an SCC/Data transfer mechanism documented, and any KMS/HSM notes?

Karthik — can you confirm whether any infra/edge proxies for this pilot will terminate outside the EU (we need region-of-processing for each path)?

Evelyn — legal may ask for a SOC 2 evidence snapshot; please indicate whether the SOC2 package is up-to-date for the vendors that process EU customer content.

Goal: reply to FinServe by Monday EOD (their regional launch is tight).

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: Natalie Blake <natalie.blake@finserve.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@finserve.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 12:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor roster + SCC/KMS checklist for EU customer onboarding

Hi Soojin — thanks for the quick note.

A few specifics from our side that will help speed review:

1) We need an itemized roster for all sub-processors that could access customer content (production and any 3rd-party devops/tools).
2) For each vendor please confirm the data residency (country/region) and whether we can get signed SCCs or a DPA addendum. If a vendor relies on our global DPA language, flag that.
3) For crypto/KMS: confirm where keys are generated and stored; if keys are in a Redwood-managed KMS, indicate the region and whether HSM-backed keys are used.
4) Attach any vendor SOC/ISO evidence you have (can be redacted).

I attached our onboarding questionnaire (vendor_questionnaire) — it lists the items our security team expects. If you can provide the roster + dataflow diagram and any SOC evidence, we'll triage and get legal sign-off.

Thanks,
Natalie

--
Natalie Blake
Head of Security Operations, FinServe Ltd.
natalie.blake@finserve.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor roster + SCC/KMS checklist for EU customer onboarding

On Fri, 05 Dec 2026 at 09:14 -0800, Soojin Lee wrote:
> We received a security/compliance intake from FinServe (see below). They're kicking off a pilot in the EU and legal asked for:
>
> - A current vendor/subprocessor roster (who touches customer content)
> - Indication of where keys are managed (KMS/HSM) for any EU-customer keys
> - Whether we have SCCs or need DPA addenda for cross-border flows
> - A simple dataflow diagram that shows any cross-border transfers

Thanks — I'll take this. Attached is a first-pass vendor roster (redwood_vendor_roster_20261205.csv). Highlights:

- Serving runtime: Hosted GPUs (managed by Redwood) — processing occurs in the EU region for the pilot (Frankfurt) except for batch analytics jobs which run in us-west (flagged). We have SCCs with our infra provider; details in the CSV.
- Telemetry/observability vendor: collects aggregated metrics; no identifiable customer content in EU flows, processing in EU/US.
- S3/backups: backups replicate to a secondary region (us-east) for DR — this is the primary cross-border path.

Action items I still need help with:
- Karthik: confirm whether the edge proxy termination point for the pilot will ever route outside EU (I believe no, but need confirmation).
- Evelyn: attaching a pointer to the SOC2 package for infra vendors — can you send the most recent PDF?

I'll send this back to FinServe with the CSV and a simple PNG dataflow map.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_roster_20261205.csv, dataflow-diagram-v1.png

--
Marissa Cole
Principal Product Manager, Platform Partnerships
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Blake <natalie.blake@finserve.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Vendor roster + SCC/KMS checklist for EU customer onboarding

Natalie — attaching the roster and dataflow diagram as discussed. High-level answers inline:

- Vendor roster: attached CSV includes name, role, data types, processing region, SCC status, KMS notes.
- SCCs/DPA: We have SCCs in place with the infra provider used for EU compute. Other vendors are on our standard DPA; for any vendor processing outside the EU we'll propose an addendum or execute SCCs as required.
- KMS/HSM: Keys for customer data in the EU pilot will be region-scoped and HSM-backed in the EU region (Frankfurt) when customer requires it.
- Cross-border paths: backups and certain analytics jobs replicate to us-west/us-east (listed in CSV).
- Evidence: Evelyn will share SOC2 excerpts under separate cover; we can redact scope as needed.

Please let us know if you need signed SCCs ahead of pilot start or if the onboarding questionnaire requires more granular evidence.

Thanks — Soojin

Attachments: redwood_vendor_roster_20261205.csv, dataflow-diagram-v1.png

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
